customer_name: Shenzhen Institute of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics for Society (AIRS)
business_problem: AIRS needed scalable compute, storage and scheduling infrastructure to tackle the algorithm, data and compute bottlenecks that were limiting embodied-intelligence research and deployment.
solution_summary: AIRS built its embodied-intelligence research environment on Baidu AI Cloud's infrastructure layer so it could combine model, data, compute and platform services in one reproducible stack. The implementation integrates GPU cloud servers, the BaiGe AI heterogeneous-compute platform, high-performance storage and Qianfan-related model services into a mixed resource pool that can support training, simulation and real-time inference workloads at the same time. That matters because AIRS is advancing several open systems: AIRSHIP for embodied systems, AIRSPEED for multimodal data generation and labeling, and AIRSTONE for low-power embodied compute. Baidu's contribution is not just raw hardware capacity; it also includes heterogenous resource scheduling, model compression support, edge-network optimization for end-cloud coordination and a parallel file system capable of storing the large sensor and training datasets generated by robotics research. The resulting environment gives AIRS a shared cloud base for embodied-model experimentation, data synthesis and deployment-oriented algorithm work.

solution_components.name: GPU Cloud Servers
solution_components.role: Provide elastic GPU capacity for model training and inference across embodied-AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Qianfan Large Model Platform
solution_components.role: Supplies model-development services used alongside AIRS's embodied-intelligence projects.

solution_components.name: BaiGe AI Heterogeneous Compute Platform
solution_components.role: Schedules mixed CPU and GPU resources for embodied-AI training, simulation and serving.

solution_components.name: High-Performance Computing Platform
solution_components.role: Delivers one-stop compute and storage services for large-scale embodied-AI experiments.

solution_components.name: Parallel File Storage
solution_components.role: Stores and serves the large data volumes produced during embodied-AI research and optimization.

data_flow: Training data, simulation outputs and real-time inference workloads are scheduled through BaiGe across CPU and GPU clusters; the resulting datasets are stored in parallel file storage and fed back into model training, evaluation and embodied-control research on the HPC platform.
business_outcome: AIRS gained a cloud-scale embodied-AI research base that improved compute utilization, supported end-to-end experimentation and accelerated the path from frontier research to industry deployment.
metrics: End-cloud coordination latency was reduced to within 50 ms.
architecture_clues: The platform forms a mixed pool of general compute and dedicated accelerators
CPU/GPU heterogenous scheduling is used across training, simulation and inference
Edge-network optimization is part of the embodied-control path
Parallel file storage underpins large multimodal datasets
evidence_quotes: AIRS faced the three core embodied-intelligence challenges of algorithms, compute and data (original: 在中游技术方面具身智能面临算法、算力和数据三重挑战).

Baidu AI Cloud built a mixed resource pool with multiple GPU specifications, CPU clusters and high-performance storage to support training, data synthesis and real-time inference (original: 整合多种性能规格GPU……CPU 集群及高性能存储，构建 “通用算力 + 专用加速” 混合资源池).
The optimization plan reduces end-cloud coordination delay to within 50 milliseconds to meet real-time robot-control requirements (original: 同时通过优化边缘节点网络，减少端云协同延时（50ms以内），满足具身机器人实时控制要求).
Parallel high-performance storage ensures that massive embodied-intelligence datasets can be stored and read efficiently (original: 高性能的并行文件存储，则确保具身智能研发中产生的海量数据得以安全、高效存储和读取).
